vb_textbox.text: At this point I think it's completely random, so I am afraid I have no helpful advice to give other than sometimes the red basket is better and sometimes the red basket is better- so if the red gives you a good amount, keep clicking gnomes with colours similar to red until it seems to switch the other way.
